headline: Approved Policy KI on visitors to the schools; also accepted Meagan Desjardins's resignation and approved the consent agenda.
summary: The meeting included reports from the superintendent, student representatives, and committees. Members approved Policy KI, Visitors to the Schools, by unanimous vote. They also accepted a resignation and approved the consent agenda.
decisions: Approved Policy KI, Visitors to the Schools, by unanimous vote.
Accepted the resignation of Meagan Desjardins by unanimous vote.
Approved the July 8, 2026 minutes by unanimous vote.

decision_evidence.quote: Marie Potvin moved to approve Policy KI; Amy Clearwater seconded. Motion passed unanimously.
Amy Clearwater moved, with regret, to accept the resignation; Marie Potvin seconded. Motion passed unanimously.
Marie Potvin moved to approve the July 8, 2026 minutes; Amy Clearwater seconded. Motion passed unanimously.
Marie Potvin moved to approve the Consent Agenda; Amy Clearwater seconded. Motion passed
